specs.title: P02 guarded real-mode transport renders server counts and truthful source metadata
capabilities crop cards and private list rows instead of showing leaked values
forbidden research data stays concealed even if rows arrive in a partial response
zero, unknown and stale metrics remain distinct with no synthetic order or run fallback
local severity filters and bounded expansions work by keyboard with exact safe resource destinations
empty truncated snapshots disclose incompleteness and disable empty expansion controls
refresh drops the old snapshot, rechecks scope and recovers without any write
offline freezes resource links, reconnect refuses revoked capability and never replays old intent
malformed resource summary refuses without fixture fallback
malformed order-mode summary refuses without fixture fallback
malformed future-source summary refuses without fixture fallback
malformed partial summary refuses without fixture fallback
malformed expired summary refuses without fixture fallback
earlier session deadline removes the shell even when context and snapshot remain valid
layout preferences persist booleans only and do not alter server authority
storage refusal preserves interactive layout and help remains reachable
P02 dark responsive layouts, keyboard and axe
P02 visual baseline dark
